description.value: Chitos Chicken & Beer is a Korean traditional fried chicken restaurant in Langley, BC, serving fresh, crispy chicken seasoned with a proprietary spice blend alongside beer and a full menu of starters, mains, sides, and rice dishes. Located in a commercial plaza on 88 Avenue, it offers dine-in and online ordering. A touring cyclist would find a substantial sit-down meal here after a ride in the Langley area.
